name: 53130 · Hales Corners, WI
findings: ZIP 53130 (Hales Corners) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53130 (Hales Corners) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53130 (Hales Corners) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
